note: Cabinet codes intentionally NOT in catalog-expected-cabinet-dims.json. The supplier PDF spec appendix does not tabulate six dimensions for these (door fronts, end panels, fillers, toe kicks, drawer-bank/variant boxes that share a tabulated sibling, or ROT-series members whose box is identical to a listed sibling). verify-catalog-integrity.ts requires dims-manifest keys + these to exactly partition the full cabinet code set, so dimension coverage can never silently shrink.
